account.title: Sign in to GeoShake
account.description: Enter your GeoShake account. Your personal connection credentials are set up automatically — your account password is not stored. Signed up with Google or Apple? Paste the API key from my.geoshake.org → Settings into the password field instead.

manual.title: Manual MQTT setup
manual.description: Enter the GeoShake MQTT credentials that came with your device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the GeoShake server. Check your network and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This GeoShake account is already configured.

data.radius_km: Alert radius from home in km (0 = all events)
